description: Nex AGI publishes open-weight agentic models and self-hosting instructions. It does not publish a first-party hosted inference API; official launch links point to third-party inference providers.

sources.notes: Official Nex-N2 launch site; distribution links are for weights, ModelScope, SiliconFlow, and OpenRouter, with no first-party hosted API documented.
Official repository documents local deployment through Nex AGI's SGLang fork.

verification.notes: Official website, repository, and model hub verified. Nex AGI publishes weights and self-hosting instructions but no first-party inference base URL, authentication scheme, model-list endpoint, rate limits, regional/data terms, or first-party pricing; direct routing remains disabled.
